scripts.dev: npm run build -w @apply-lite/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c auto "npm run dev -w @apply-lite/api" "npm run dev -w @apply-lite/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @apply-lite/shared && npm run dev -w @apply-lite/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @apply-lite/shared && npm run build -w @apply-lite/api && npm run build -w @apply-lite/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @apply-lite/shared && npm run typecheck -w @apply-lite/api && npm run typecheck -w @apply-lite/web
scripts.regression:m9: npm run build -w @apply-lite/shared && npm run regression:m9 -w @apply-lite/api
scripts.regression:m10: npm run build -w @apply-lite/shared && npm run regression:m10 -w @apply-lite/api
scripts.regression:discovery: npm run build -w @apply-lite/shared && npm run regression:discovery -w @apply-lite/api
scripts.regression:reliability: npm run build -w @apply-lite/shared && npm run regression:reliability -w @apply-lite/api
scripts.test: npm run regression:reliability && npm run regression:discovery && npm run regression:edge -w @apply-lite/api && npm run regression:workflow
scripts.regression:browser: npm run build && npm run regression:browser -w @apply-lite/api
scripts.regression:workflow: npm run build -w @apply-lite/shared && npm run regression:workflow -w @apply-lite/api
